entities.summary: Fernando Lamikiz Garai is a lawyer, economist and former president of Athletic Bilbao. Lamikiz studied economic law at the Deusto University. After further studying in Munich, he returned to Deusto as a lecturer in Civil Rights. He was member of the board of directors of Athletic from 1994 to 2001, heading the legal department.
